notes: Camp set at 550 px = 1 m: canvas swag rolled (1.09 m long, ~0.42 m dia) and laid out, a two-burner camp stove (0.64 x 0.35 m; 0.13 m closed; open: 0.095 m base with the lid standing to ~0.475 m and short sloped wind panels reaching only to mid-depth) and a galvanised food box (~0.55 x 0.33 x 0.26 m); open swag perspective, open stove front perspective and open food box are left out. Unclear: the laid-out swag measures only 1.25 m by the bar, so it is modelled at 1.95 m canvas length with the drawing's proportions; the second-row roll, the small end circle, the stove top view and the food box back view are drawn at inconsistent scales and are used as back/end/top views anyway.
